name: patchfuil
description: patchfuil (pfui): a compiled, declarative UI framework in the spirit of XMLUI

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/compiler && tsc -p packages/runtime && tsc -p packages/components && tsc -p packages/standalone && tsc -p packages/vite-plugin && tsc -p packages/mock-backend && tsc -p tools && tsc -p test-apps/smoke && tsc -p test-apps/hello && tsc -p test-apps/routing && tsc -p test-apps/data && tsc -p playground && tsc -p e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.playground:preview: npm run playground:build && vite preview --config playground/vite.config.ts --configLoader runner --outDir ../.tmp/playground-dist
